content.value: A rectangular plate of size 30 cm by 50 cm and weighing 26 N slides down a 32° inclined surface at a uniform velocity of 2.2 m/sec. If the uniform 2 mm gap between the plate and the inclined surface is filled with oil, determine the viscosity of the oil.
